article.title: Israel’s grip on American politics is finally being questioned
article.author: Philip Weiss
article.content: From Iraq to Iran, the Israel lobby has, for decades, pushed America towards wars in the Middle East. But with Trump’s wildly unpopular Iran war, the unshakeable power of the Israel lobby is finally being called into question.
